<%= lc_prose do %>

Make room for the trip

A shared plan is easier to follow when each idea has room to breathe. Keep the essentials close and give a new topic a little more space.

Start with one clear decision, name the plan kyoto-weekend, then choose what comes next.

  • Choose a place to stay.
  • Set aside time for a slow morning.
  • Leave an afternoon open.

The best part of a plan is the space it leaves for a surprise.

Ready to begin?

Buttons and other app controls can opt out of reading styles.

<%= lc_button "Create a plan" %>
<% end %>

examples.title: Japanese reading

旅の計画に、少しの余白を。

みんなで予定を考えるときは、大切なことから順番に決めていきましょう。読みやすい行間と段落の間隔が、長い文章をたどる手助けになります。

最初に決めておきたいこと

  • 集合する場所と時間
  • みんなで分ける費用
  • 自由に過ごす時間

予定が変わったら、グループにひとこと。少しの共有で、旅がもっと気軽になります。

何もしない時間も、旅の楽しみのひとつです。

<% end %>

blocks.title: Documentation layout
blocks.description: A sidebar, page content and an "On this page" list, with a collapsible menu on phones.
notes: lc_docs_shell takes the sidebar as navigation: and an lc_toc as contents:, with the page as its block. This documentation site uses it for every guide and component page.
Mark the current page with current: true so the sidebar sets aria-current. The contents list appears from the xl breakpoint and marks the section you have scrolled to.

<% navigation = lc_nav_list label: "Guides" do |nav| %>
  <%= nav.group "Getting started" do %>
    <%= nav.link "Introduction", "#introduction", current: true %>
    <%= nav.link "Install", "#install" %>
  <% end %>
  <%= nav.group "Guides" do %>
    <%= nav.link "Accounts", "#accounts" %>
    <%= nav.link "Billing", "#billing" %>
    <%= nav.link "Webhooks", "#webhooks" %>
  <% end %>
<% end %>
<% contents = lc_toc do |toc| %>
  <%= toc.link "Requirements", "#requirements" %>

  <%= toc.link "Next steps", "#next" %>

<%= lc_docs_shell navigation:, contents:, menu_label: "Guides" do %>

    <header id="introduction" class="<%= lc_stack_class(gap: :heading) %>">
      <%= lc_breadcrumb [ [ "Docs", "#introduction" ], "Introduction" ] %>
      <%= lc_heading "Introduction", level: 1, size: :title %>
      <%= lc_text "Everything you need to connect your workspace.", tone: :muted %>

    <%= lc_section title: "Requirements", id: "requirements", anchor: true do %>
      <%= lc_text "An account with owner access and an API key from your settings.", size: :small, tone: :muted %>

      <%= lc_text "Create a key for each environment and keep it out of your repository.", size: :small, tone: :muted %>
    <% end %>
    <%= lc_section title: "Next steps", id: "next", anchor: true do %>
      <%= lc_text do %>Read the <%= lc_link "install guide", "#install" %> to make your first request.<% end %>
    <% end %>
    <%= lc_pager next: [ "Install", "#install" ] %>
  <% end %>
<% end %>

<%= lc_dock do |dock| %> <%= dock.nav label: "Studio sections" do |nav| %> <% [ [ "Projects", "projects", "rectangle-stack" ], [ "Notes", "notes", "document-text" ], [ "People", "people", "users" ] ].each do |label, id, icon| %> <%= nav.link label, "##{id}", icon:, current: id == "projects", data: { action: "blocks-mobile-navigation#select" } %> <% end %> <% end %> <%= dock.menu label: "Create something", id: "studio-create-menu" do |menu| %> <%= menu.action "New project", icon: "rectangle-stack", data: { action: "blocks-mobile-navigation#add", blocks_mobile_navigation_destination_param: "projects" } %> <%= menu.action "Add a note", icon: "pencil-square", data: { action: "blocks-mobile-navigation#add", blocks_mobile_navigation_destination_param: "notes" } %> <% end %> <% end %>

color_roles.--card-secondary: Secondary buttons on cards; defaults to --secondary
color_roles.--popover-foreground: Text on menus, popovers and dialogs
color_roles.--primary: Primary actions, links, selected states and keyboard focus
color_roles.--primary-foreground: Text and icons on a solid primary background
color_roles.--muted: Subtle backgrounds: badges, code, skeletons, table headers
color_roles.--accent: Hovered rows, menu items and inline code
color_roles.--ring: Keyboard focus ring; unset, it follows --primary

styles: lc_avatar_class(size: :md, ink: false, linked: false, extra: nil)
lc_toggle_class(active: false, ghost: false, size: :md, extra: nil)
lc_button_class(variant: :primary, tone: :default, size: :md, block: false, extra: nil)
lc_icon_button_class(shape: :square, size: :md, variant: :ghost, tone: :default, extra: nil)
lc_text_class(size: :body, tone: :default, trim: false, extra: nil)
